notes.title: Major Update 2.3.389: The Ancient Swarm, New Bonuses, and Skills
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/14705ed38c595511d0b6ec4587e2a0e243c03592.png"]

This update introduces an increase in maximum health, new skill bonuses, and improvements to the Brongart dungeon - including valuable unique rewards, a merchant, balance enhancements, and much more.



Get Wild Terra 2 and packs:

https://wildterra2.com/

 

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Update 2.3.389:
The Ancient Swarm and Brongart:
- A new NPC "Envoy of the Ancient Swarm" has been added to the Brongart dungeon, where you can purchase rare items.

- A new exotic item, "Belt of the Ancient Swarm," has been added, featuring 3 levels of upgrades.

- A new shrine of the Ancient Swarm has been introduced, with 2 levels of upgrades; pilgrimage to this shrine will temporarily increase your health.

- A decorative fence set made from Ancient Swarm materials has been added.

- Four new skins for riding animals in the style of the "Ancient Swarm" bugs have been introduced. One unique skin can be obtained by defeating the overseer of the miners, "The Chopper," on Nightmare difficulty, while the others can be purchased from the Ancient Swarm merchant.

- A unique skin "Swarm Coordinator" for a riding animal has been added, with a chance to obtain it by defeating the Swarm Coordinator "The Hollow One" on Nightmare difficulty.

- A new pet "Larva of the Ancient Swarm" has been added, which can be raised from an Ancient Swarm Egg.

- A new resource type called "Biomass of Ancient Swarm Invaders" has been introduced, which is used in crafting and building.

- Balance adjustments and changes to the number of monsters in the Brongart dungeon have been made.

- The number of rare ore deposits in the Brongart dungeon has been increased.

- Pathing issues in some areas of the Brongart dungeon have been fixed.

- The rewards in the final chest of Fort Brongart have been improved (Sulfur has been added).

- A chance to find Sulfur has been added to the loot of Fort Brongart.

- The stack size for all body parts of the Ancient Swarm has been increased.

- A bug causing torches to float in the air in Fort Brongart has been fixed.

New Bonuses and Skills:
- A new bonus "Health" has been added, increasing the player's maximum health.

- In the heavy armor set of Sangium, the "Player Protection" bonus has been replaced with the "Health" bonus.

- Three new passive skills for Blacksmithing have been added at skill levels 40-60-65.

- Two new passive skills and one active skill for Leatherworking have been added at skill levels 40-50-60.

- One new active skill for Jewelcrafting has been added at skill level 50.

- One new passive skill for Healing has been added at skill level 50.

Buildings:
- The festive table now restores 100 of each type of satiety instead of 50.

- The size of the Jewel Table has been fixed; it now fits exactly in 2 cells and can be placed against walls and stairs.

- It is now possible to place iron and steel anvils on the foundation and inside rooms of the house.

- You can now build a second floor above the Chicken Coop and Rabbit Hutch.

- A bug that allowed placing a bed in certain areas of the PvP zone in the Valley of Ancestors has been fixed.

- The size of the Dining Table has been adjusted, allowing it to be built near walls and foundations.

- The planting area size of 2x2 has been fixed, so it can now be placed next to trees.

- You can now use sturdy wood materials as fuel in the campfire.


Other Changes and Fixes:
- The recipes for "Craft Beer 'Cherry Jubilee'" and "Dark Craft Beer 'Blue Porter'" have been modified. Tips for the new recipes can now be found in the Traveler's notes.

- Several new notes from the Traveler's Diary have been added.

- A bug with teleportation in the city to the "Long Ascent" has been fixed.

- A bug in the recipe for creating the skin for the Riding Deer has been fixed.

- The recipe for creating the skin for the Riding Bear has been changed, and a bug that affected experience gain when crafting the skin has been fixed.

- The campfire location in Ragnara's camp has been adjusted to prevent players from getting stuck when passing between it and Ragnar.

- A bug in the Abandoned Iron Mine has been fixed, where the exit from the mine was unavailable in some cases during room generation.

- A bug with the spawning of objects in an inaccessible location under the tavern door has been fixed.

- The ransom price for "Cultist Blood" from the NPC has been reduced by half.

notes.title: Update 2.3.388. Training arena, mount skins, more routes for Transporters
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/44843dbc49178e2b44b8fe441925addd93f5cc89.png

A training arena for practice fights or amateur tournaments has been added to the city, along with 15 new mount skins, new routes for Transporters, and other improvements

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Update 2.3.388

Training Arena:
- A new effect "Battle Arena" has been added.
- A new area with a closed arena has been added to the city, where practice fights or amateur tournaments can take place. Near the training arena, an Arena Master has been added, allowing players to save, like at a bed.

Other changes and fixes:
- 15 mount skins from all packs (including Zebra) have been added.
- The price for services with Transporters has been halved. Five new transport locations have been added: Long Ascent, Lumberjack Camp, Miner’s Camp, Abandoned Church, Brongart. Transport is available only in one direction and not with all Transporters.
- Five new potions for object finding have been added (Blueberry, Lingonberry, Wild Strawberry, Ramsons, Mountain Sage). The application time for all object-finding potions has been reduced to 3 seconds.
- Fixed an issue with skill book labels in containers, in the NPC purchase window, and in the exchange window between players.
- A visual display of the active state has been added for the Alchemical Cube.
- Fixed a bug with the space occupied by the Witcher's Cauldron; it now fits in 1 cell and does not block adjacent cells.
- The spawn rate of seagulls on the beach of the main continent has doubled.
- Descriptions for items that can be converted into mount skins have been updated. Additionally, the button name within the item has been updated.
- Fixed a rare bug when generating rooms in the Abandoned Iron Mine, where several iron ore deposits were inaccessible for mining.
- Fixed a bug in room generation in the Dark Forest dungeon, where some monsters appeared in inaccessible locations.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented object highlighting through potions.

notes.title: Easter Event and Update 2.3.386: Mr. Bunny's Quests
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/e5f681034ac8024d7d83c3e1e3484471b92935e2.png

The Easter event has begun in the world of Wild Terra 2. Complete festive tasks from Mr. Bunny, search for Easter eggs and lost baskets, try new dishes, and treat your friends! Unique rewards await you. The event will last for 2-3 weeks, and the exact end date will be announced later.

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Update 2.3.386
Easter Event:
- Mr. Bunny has appeared in the town, where you can take quests and purchase items.
- 5 Easter dishes have been added for restoring fullness.
- 2 Easter dishes with unique effects have been added (these dishes can be obtained as rewards for quests).
- 2 types of unique Easter eggs have been added for restoring inspiration and boosting pet experience (they can be found in Easter eggs and Easter baskets in the world).
- 6 Easter resources have been added for crafting new items and dishes.
- A separate "Easter" branch with new recipes has been added to the crafting window.
- 2 new objects, "Easter Eggs" and "Lost Easter Basket," have been added to the world, which can be found across the main continent, including its desert part.
- You can also find "Easter Eggs" near the executioner's grave in the town cemetery.
- A chain of 10 Easter quests has been added, which can be started in the town with Mr. Bunny.
- 20 daily Easter quests have been added, which can be completed after finishing the main quest chain. You will receive 2 quests per day!
- A unique mount skin, "Riding White Rabbit," has been added (available for purchase from Mr. Bunny).
- A unique backpack skin, "Easter Backpack," has been added (available for purchase from Mr. Bunny).

Mounts and Witchcraft:
- Mounts available in the in-game shop can now be transformed into skins instead of keeping the mount. The mount itself will be lost!
- The option to create a mount skin for the Barghest in the witch's cauldron has been added.
- The drop chance for the Barghest skin from the demon in the basement has been increased from 1% to 5%.
- 5 recipes for creating basic mount skins (Goat, Boar, Deer, Wolf, Bear) have been added to the exotic item crafting system via the leatherworking skill.
- 8 new potions have been added in Witchcraft to highlight objects in the game world.
- 2 new ingredients for Witchcraft (Transmorpha Potions) can be purchased from the witch in the town.
- 5 new mount skins can be brewed in the witch's cauldron.

Other Improvements and Fixes:
- The default quantity of items sold by all merchants is now set to 1 (as the exact amount can be specified during purchase).
- A recipe for "Glass Melting Mixture" has been added to the Pottery Machine.
- "Chitin" has been added to the armor crafting recipe for "Reinforced Leather."
- Skill books now include descriptions in inventories.
- The cooldown time for the "Absolute Protection" bonus in the "Guardian's Shield" has been increased from 40 to 50 seconds.
- A bug that prevented clay excavation from being counted in the "Buried Treasure" quest has been fixed.
- A bug causing the tutorial arrow to point to the ranged weapon button instead of the melee button has been fixed.
- The volume of heavy and very heavy footsteps from large mounts and monsters, as well as the sound of dragon wings flapping, has been reduced.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.3.384
notes.notes:
- A new slow heavy bow has been added to replace the fixed composite bow.  
- New types of more powerful crossbow bolts with special effects have been added.  
- The skill requirements for top-tier light armor and light shields have been fixed to better align with equipment progression.  
- A bug has been fixed where bonuses related to the new skills Crossbows and Engineering were not included in the bonuses for Jewelcrafting.  
- The Heavy Armor skill requirements for armor made of Sangite, Zuperite, and Morbium have been corrected to better match the progression of their respective weapon types.  
- A bug with certain types of projectiles fired by monsters and pets has been fixed, causing them to sometimes miss their target.  
- A bug has been fixed where Ancient Engineer Mechanisms were not dropping in Brongart.  
- A bug has been fixed where Crossbows were categorized as Swords. Listings that were already created will need to be relisted.  
- A sound has been added for the digging animation.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.3.383
notes.notes:
- The number of slots for the Large bloomery and the Large Pottery Kiln, as well as almost all ancient machines, has been increased.
- Water production in the automatic machine has been increased by 5 times.
- The number of crossbow bolts in one slot has been increased to 100.
- A bug with the number of feathers for arrows in the automatic machine has been fixed.
- The icon for the Engineering Table and the icon for the Workbench effect have been corrected.
- The number of bolts received during crafting has been increased, and even more profitable recipes have been added to the automatic machine.
- A bug with the crossbows range has been fixed.
- The position of engineering tools in hand has been corrected.
- Bugs in desert spawns have been fixed.
- A bug that caused the Protofrog pet to lack a bonus at level 40 has been fixed; it now grants an increase in the Witchery skill.
- A bug that caused the Reaper to potentially not display previously gained effects has been fixed.
- A bug that caused Crossbows to fall into the Axes category on the auction has been fixed. Listings that were already created will need to be relisted.

notes.title: Major Update 2.3.382: Engineering, Crossbows, and Free Demo
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/4d5e17ff09ef1432f765b4cdc064c73289c188a3.png
In this update, we have introduced two new skills: Crossbows and Engineering. The update also includes new pets (with the long-awaited Dalmatian!), new resources, recipes, and more than 30 other changes and fixes.

Additionally, you can now try the game for free through the demo available on the Wild Terra 2 Steam page! The demo version is limited to Starter Island and is available until you complete all quests on it.

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Major Update 2.3.382

Crossbows:
- A new skill, Crossbows, has been added. Shots from crossbows ignore blocks and dodges, but there is a reload period after each shot. However, the low rate of fire is compensated by powerful piercing damage and new active and passive abilities. Additional damage from crossbows heavily depends on the bolts used.
- Several types of crossbows and bolts for them have been added to crafting.
This is not yet the final version of the skill; we look forward to your feedback and suggestions!

Engineering:
- A new skill, Engineering, has been added. It allows you to build automated machines, create crossbows, and a new pet.
- A new bonus and item Engineer Tools have been introduced.
- A new crafting table and the Engineering Table effect have been added.
- 14 new resources for crafting in Engineering have been added.
- The Solution Machine has been added, allowing the production of leather solutions (4 recipes).
- Construction requirements for all machines have been updated; now the Engineering skill and additional resources are required.

Pets:
- A Dalmatian pet has been added. This pet is included in the "Home, Sweet Home" pack. To obtain it, you need to re-enter the pack code in the server selection window. If you cannot find the code, you can contact the payment system support: https://help.xsolla.com/
- An Ancient Self-Driving Guardian pet has been added, which can be created using Engineering.
- The Reaper pet will no longer receive the attacking effect Provoke when leveling up to the maximum level.
- All pets have had bonuses for leveling Engineering and Crossbows added to their corresponding random lists.
- A bug has been fixed that caused the position of distant attack pets' targets to not be taken into account in terms of height.
- A bug has been fixed that caused pet experience information to be overlapped by the interface button.
- Minor balance changes for pets have been made.

Weapons:
- All weapon skill categories have been divided into two tabs: melee and ranged combat.
- Plague damage has been increased for all versions of reptilian weapons.
- Reptilian weapons now have tool and crafting building requirements.
- The initial transferable versions of reptilian weapons now have production skill requirements to match the logic of obtaining other exotic weapons.
- The parameter progression for all bows has been changed, as quality material bows were underutilized.
- The amount of steel required for the composite bow has been reduced, but the amount of wood has been increased.
- When wearing a weapon and hovering over compatible equipment, the tooltip will now display total damage per second, taking into account additional damage from that equipment (for example, arrows and other projectiles).
- Some skill values for crafting plague weapons have been adjusted.

Other Innovations and Fixes:
- A bug has been fixed that caused achievements not to be awarded on the PvE server.
- A bonus and a new passive ability for Jewelcrafting, related to the lower and upper quality limits of products, have been added.
- Pottery is now an auxiliary skill and has been moved to the corresponding section.
- A new resource, Sand Deposits, has been added to the desert region and the beach (as well as in the Naturalist Journal).
- Items "Glass Smelting Mixture," "Glass," and the ability to craft an "Empty Flask" have been added.
- The water pump now requires sand to produce water (instead of hides).
- In the pottery machine, lime and lime solution have been replaced with sand and bark solution.
- In the ammunition machine, the number of feathers needed for arrows has been reduced by 1 in all recipes.
- The number of slots in the "Trade" window between players has been increased by 5.
- The number of slots in the "Large bloomery" has been increased by 5.
- A filtering and sorting panel has been added to the "Large bloomery" and "Large pottery kiln".
- The icons for the effects "Workbench" and "Hand Mill" have been updated.
- New art for loading screens and the main menu has been added.
- Chat will now be disabled until the ship training is completed, which should help improve the situation with spam.
- A bug has been fixed that allowed the chat to create line breaks in a way that made it appear as if a different person was writing from a new line.
- A display bug has been fixed that caused the chance of taming animals to exceed 100%.
- A bug has been fixed that requires players to re-enter the game to receive purchases in the in-game shop on the PvE server.
- A bug has been fixed that caused holy swords to be visible in the equipment window.
- The correct animation for digging will now be used when harvesting clay and sand.
- The names of experience books have been fixed to fit in the trade window.

notes.title: Update 380. Christmas event has ended, loot rights updated, inventory scaling
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/88c8b90290f1f408337dfe6ac63a6a231c189a9d.jpg

The Christmas event has ended, but you can still craft related items until January 19th. Loot rights on the PvE server are now granted to all group members. The inventory window now automatically adjusts its height. These and other changes are included in update 2.2.380.

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/


Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Update 2.2.380

What's New:
- The Christmas event has concluded. All crafting related to the event will remain available until January 19.
- Loot rights and gathering on the PvE server are now permitted for all group members. The player who deals damage first is designated as the owner of the corpse. Even if they leave the group after the monster's death, they will still be able to loot it.
- The Inventory interface has been improved. The height auto-expansion feature has been adjusted based on the number of slots (to eliminate vertical scrolling).
- You can now leave the territory of any dominium via a new action. This will help prevent situations where players get trapped in another player's dominium.
- Moderators and developers can now enable the appropriate titles for their roles: Inquisitor and Creator.

Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where premium scrolls did not add time but instead overwritten it.
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to build Beds and Campfires in certain zones where it was not intended by the game.

notes.title: Update 2.2.379. Coachmans, inventory expansion, and more
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/589ae0659dc3fd2f851acac4e31ea079fca7a439.png

This update introduces Coachmans, which will help players instantly travel to desired locations (for example, to settle in the Ancestors Valley in Southern Iteria). The inventory size has been increased, new Agriculture abilities have been added, swords and Witchcraft abilities have been strengthened.

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Update 2.2.379

What's New:
- Coachmans have been added near the tavern, in the City, and at the Port, allowing players to be transported to their desired location for a small fee. The stablehand no longer handles this.
- A Coachman has also been added in the Desert on the PvE server. Remember, you can build and set up dominiums in the Ancestors Valley in the desert, and the Coach will make this even more convenient. 
- The cost of relocation for small and medium dominiums has been reduced by 10 times.
- The inventory size has been increased by 5 slots.
- Four new passive Agriculture abilities have been added.
- Leather Belt and Hardened Leather Belt now provide 1 extra slot, allowing for 5 additional quick access slots in the early stages of the game.
- You can now hang a Christmas wreath on Marble and Castle gates.

Witchcraft:
- The attack power and critical hit chance of Witcher swords have been increased.
- Battle Thirst is no longer interrupted by damage taken. Health consumption is reduced by half.
- Fire Blast is no longer interrupted by damage taken. Self-ignition duration has been reduced from 5 seconds to 2 seconds. Cooldown has been decreased from 30 to 25 seconds. Base damage has increased by 15%.
- Weakness: base casting speed has been reduced from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.

Fixes:
- Spawn rates for nests and ores in the plains and forests of Iteria have been increased.
- To reduce server load, the density of insignificant spawns and instant respawns has been optimized.
- The number of daily quests given by the fisherman has been reduced from 3 to 2.
- The monetary rewards for daily quests from the fisherman have been decreased, but resource rewards have been increased.
- For the active ability Gatherer’s Experience, a casting time of 4 seconds (with the option to interrupt) has been added, and the cooldown has been increased to 90 seconds.
- The progression of characteristics for the first tiers of the Miner’s Backpack is now smoother (more slots and less slowdown).
- The icon of the scroll above loading screen hints has been changed.
- Fixed invisible walls in the Echo Cave.
- Fixed an issue with an invisible wall in the swamps.
- Fixed a bug with passing through walls in the city.

notes.title: Update 2.2.378. Snow, server optimizations and fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/3a738523675c6d03ee60f5946387fa7050b444ac.jpg
In this small update, the lands of Iteria and Elyon are covered in snow, several bugs have been fixed, and improvements have been made to reduce server load.

We ask for your help in gathering spawn clusters in construction zones on the main continent, along rivers, and other dense deposits at the edges of these areas (as well as clearing them of animals).

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Update 2.2.378

Changes and Fixes:  
- Reduced the spawn of objects on Iteria in building zones.  
- Decreased the lifespan of items dropped on the ground and open godsends.  
- Renamed server designations for better understanding of their focus: “Main Servers” and “No PvP Servers.”  
- Added snow to some territories of Elyon and Iteria, and disabled grass.  
- Fixed a bug that caused corpses to stop disappearing upon looting on PvE servers.  
- Fixed a bug where bonuses might not display in the equipment window.  
- Further increased the collider of garden plots to prevent stacking multiple plots vertically.

notes.title: Update 2.2.377. The Christmas Events Begin!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/82bed19488a1769acf1bd0fcbfacdbc4aa0cc32e.png

Krampus has returned and stolen the gifts of Iteria's inhabitants! But this is only a small part of the winter story you'll need to unravel, along with the Ragnara. Locals are reporting increasingly frequent encounters with undead who call themselves Dragon Keepers. This update brings a large amount of new content for both new and veteran players.

Also, festive items and bundles are available at a discount in the in-game store, and you can get free festive frames and icons!

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/  

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Update 2.2.377

Christmas Event:
- A quest chain and daily tasks have been added for Ragnara, to tell you about the ongoing events.
- A character dressed as Santa has been added to Hartfurt, selling consumables for crafting decorations for your dominion, Christmas items, and gives out a Christmas gift to anyone who asks every day!
- Portals to Krampus' Winter Forest and winter creatures are appearing throughout Iteria.
- You can find gray squirrels in the forests and fields, and polar wolves in PvP zones; skinning them might open a portal to the Winter Forest.
- Mad elves can be encountered in the Winter Forest, as well as when chopping down fir trees, pine trees, and trees on Plague Island.
- Dragon Keepers, undead creatures, have been added and can be found in the Winter Forest, the Iterian swamp, and Plague Island.
- Skinning Dragon Keepers in the swamps have a chance to spawn a stronger monster, and at the end of the chain, you will face the key boss, the Horned Dragon.
- An Eye of the Dragon organ can drop from the servant Dragon Keepers in the winter dungeon, allowing you to summon a solo version of the Horned Dragon boss in the tavern basement. The dungeon difficulty affects the drop rate.
- There is a chance to find a dragon egg in the remains of the defeated dragon and in Christmas gifts, allowing you to raise your own baby dragon!
- Christmas items have been added to loot finds and corpse containers.
- The Christmas tree recipe and crafting of Christmas items are once again available.
- Christmas gifts can contain themed rewards, as well as "Dungeon Hourglasses," which allow you to reset dungeon activity timers.
- New event rewards include useful consumables and unique decorations (capes, mount skins). New capes and mount skins can be found in Christmas gifts and from Krampus' loot.
- The inhabitants of Iteria have decorated Hartfurt and the tavern for Christmas.

Other new features:
- On the PvE server, loot can now be obtained only by the first player to attack (this information is accompanied by a red flag icon).
- Due to space constraints and excessive load on the PvE server, the offline lifespan of dominions has been reduced until they are automatically packed.
- A decorative slot for mounts has been added. In the future, we will enable the exchange of most acquired animals for "decorative" ones (to be used in this slot).
- A new mount skin "Demonic Barguest" has been added, which can be obtained from the loot of the "Weak Demon" in the tavern basement.
- All mechanical machines can now be built anywhere, not just on the ground (except for the "Water Pump").
- An additional row of slots has been added to the inventory of all mechanical machines.
- The spawn rate of "Stone Column Parts from Brongarta" has been increased in the desert region.

Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where the plant growth bonus was not working correctly.
- Fixed a bug that caused the statue in memory of Kirill kvadrakloid to disappear.
- Fixed a bug that allowed building garden plots on top of each other.
- Fixed a z-fighting texture issue with the Hand Mill on the table.
- Fixed spawn and traversal issues in the mountain region at the mountain peak and the stable house by the tavern.
- Fixed a bug with the Krampus model.
- Fixed descriptive errors for some items and quests.

notes.title: PvE server and Major Update 2.2.375. Mechanical machines, New quests and Premium
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/bf96ec31ee50a813a9cf46a357110b0e3ea76a58.png

The PvE server is now live in Europe!
(Available for other regions as well; if you have a comfortable ping, you can play without restrictions.)

You can expect a welcome bonus on all servers! Until December 16, new characters on any server receive a 14-day bonus of +200% experience.

For the opening, we have launched a major update and a special Landowner Pack available in the in-game store and Steam. The update includes Mechanical machines (which simplify the crafting of arrows and materials for various professions), new resources and production schems, 20 daily quests, and new godsends. Premium bonus (available for Gold and Runes) and new NPC have also been added.

Get Wild Terra 2 and packs: https://wildterra2.com/

Thank you very much for your activity, feedback, and support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with every update!

Changelog for Major Update 2.2.375

PvE Server and Legacy:
- The PvE server is now live in Europe. Remember, until December 16, all new characters receive a +200% experience bonus for 14 days on all servers.
- On this server, players and their pets cannot attack other players and pets, nor loot the bodies of other characters.
- The PvE server has a separate Auction.
- Outdated Legacy servers have been closed.

Landowner Pack:
A new Landowner Pack is available on Steam and the in-game store:
- Riding Longhorn Bull (speed 90).
- Goose pet with non-combat abilities.
- Peaceful Traveler's Backpack. Back decoration (+5 slots).
- Stylish Farmer's Hat. Head decoration.
- Decorative Scarecrow building.
- Title: Landowner.
- Character portraits.

Mechanical Machines and New Quests:
- 7 mechanical machines have been added to simplify the creation of arrows and materials for various professions.
- 2 new materials and a unique fuel for mechanical machines have been added.
- Over 30 production schematics related to new resources and mechanical machines have been added.
- Mountain Engineers have been added: three citizens of Iteria who offer daily quests. One is settled in the mountainous region, the second in the miners' camp, and the third in the desert part of the continent.
- 20 daily quests for gathering new materials have been added.
- 5 new quest items have been added.
- 3 types of godsends in the desert region have been added for gathering quest items.

Premium Bonus:
- A Premium bonus has been added - activatable by scroll with durations of 7, 30, and 365 days.
- 30 days of premium can be purchased for in-game currency (Gold) in Hartfurt.
- Scrolls for 7, 30, and 365 days are available in the in-game store for Runes.

Other Changes:
- In Hartfurt, the Mayor has come out to the square to meet the citizens. You can now purchase Land Deeds, a 30-day premium scroll, and register a new guild from him. The Mayor has also reviewed the tax rate in the city, resulting in some price changes.
- The Mayor learned about the Librarian's illegal business. The old man had his Land Deeds and guild registration seal confiscated. The citizens called for the Librarian's pardon, but he now only trades books.
- Prices for purchasing Land Deeds have been updated.
- Prices for selling fish to traders have been updated.
- Prices for purchasing certain materials from city traders have been updated.
- Repair prices for some sets of light armor have been updated.
- New art has been added for the loading screen and main menu.
- The duration of the Dominium activity on the starting island has been reduced to 48 hours.
- The ability to cut off the ear from the body of another player's character has been added.
- Fixed bugs with passability to inaccessible areas of Elion and in the southern part of Iteria.
- Fixed errors in the descriptions of some quests, effects, and items.

notes.title: Major Update 367. New group dungeon, exotic weapons, friends list and more
notes.notes:

Changing projectiles and bolases:
- Increased bolases flight speed.
- Reduced bolases creation time from 5s to 4s.
- Increased the number of bolases received at crafting from 1 to 3.
- Now the higher the level of the target, the higher the level of arrows and projectiles of thrown weapons will be required to effectively deal damage. Higher level targets take reduced damage per level (5%) and are immune to attack effects.

Combat balance changes:
- The sling now requires two hands.

- Sprint ability. Effect duration 5s -> 4s. Cooldown time 20s -> 25s.
- Passive ability "Dodge Speed". Speed bonus 40% -> 50%. Effect duration 3s -> 0.3s.

- Most Heavy Shield skills now cost less stamina.
- Ability "Heavy shield strike". Stun duration 3s -> 3.5s. Damage from a weapon 10% -> 50%.
- Ability "Light shield strike". Stun duration 2s -> 1.5s. Damage from a weapon 25% -> 15%.
- Decreased the duration of skills that increase the chance of blocking with a shield, and now the bonus does not increase the block from ranged attacks. This effect does not appear in the player's bonus list.
- Ability "Backstab". Ignore absorption 100% -> 85%. Chance of bleeding 100% -> 70%. Bleed duration 8s -> 6s.
- All shields have slightly reduced Arrow Block.
- Changed the characteristics of the Target Shield.
- Bow Dark Night added absorption penetration, on tier 2 - 10%, on tier 3 - 20%, on 4 - 30%.
- Added temporary immunity to the repeated slow to Ent.
- Added temporary immunity to the repetitive stun and slow to the Plague Ogre.
- Dwarf officers and commanders have a 50% chance of temporary immunity to repeated stuns and slows.
- Added new master marks for weapons, plagued weapons have additional master marks against plague monsters.
- Now bonuses for crit chance, damage to animals or damage to insects and spiders (depending on the pet) work against pets.

In the mountain gorge of the Winter Forest, the warlock Krampus and his demented elves decided to create bewitched toys - Black Rabbits (a symbol of 2023), the toys were supposed to reincarnate alive, steal Christmas gifts and naughty kids. The experiment was not entirely successful, most of the rabbits turned out to be white, some of them mutated (some of them many times), the toys refused to listen to their leader, but the warlock did not give up.
 
Krampus created portals throughout Iteria and sent rabbits to steal gifts and naughty children. The hermit Ragnara saw a portal in the forest, the elves of Krampus and his rabbits, and guessed everything. She told the residents of Hartfurt and they decided to teach Krampus a lesson by hiding branches, stones and other things that they didn’t really need under the guise of gifts. Update 2.1.309. Changelog

Animal husbandry:
This is the first stage of adding Animal Husbandry to the game. Later we will add new animals, as well as mechanics for breeding pets.
- A new skill Animal Husbandry has been added to the game, necessary for breeding livestock, pets and obtaining resources from it.
- In Hartfurt, you can find Ermak - a merchant selling animals and other products for Animal Husbandry.

- Added buildings for animal husbandry: Incubator, Chicken Coop, Rabbit Coop, Pigsty and Cowshed.
- Depending on the gender of the animals and food, leaving the animal in it coop, you can get either a cub or resources.
- Added new resources that can be obtained from Animal Husbandry. They can be used in other recipes or sold.
- Added Hay. Can be obtained by harvesting Barley and Wheat.
- Added Animal Fat. Can be obtained by butchering domestic and wild boars and pigs.
- Added raw cow meat. Can be obtained by butchering a domestic cow.

Equipment level requirement:
Without these changes, it was possible to equip high-tier equipment on a rookie character and gain additional benefits. The cost of intermediate equipment (even of high quality) was also extremely low as it was not needed. We decided to make the leveling more consistent.
- For armor, shields, tools and weapons, the levels of the required skill have been introduced. If you equip an item with a skill requirement higher than your level, the item's stats will be lowered. The greater the difference in level, the greater the penalty.
- Improved display of information in the equipment tooltip.

Large leader-animals:
- Added 15 new large animals and monsters of Iteria and its dungeons. Large animals are much rarer, have increased stats and rewards. Some of these animals can be tamed. 
- A new type of food has been added to crafting, which is necessary for taming some leaders.

Changes in the combat system:
In this update, we have begun combat balance changes. Under testing conditions, it is difficult to check all possible scenarios for using weapons, abilities, target characteristics and their combinations, so biases in one direction or another are likely. Also, some of the changes will be introduced sequentially. Hope for your understanding. We will continue to adjust the balance after the update.
We want the combat system to have a place for different roles and playstyles, but the Sling turned out to be too formidable weapon due to range, control and high damage with heavy crits, leaving all other weapons aside, so we decided to reduce its characteristics in several directions.
Slings: 
- Changed base damage, significantly reduced critical damage.
- Spiked projectiles have reduced absorption ignore 25%  33%.

Let's move on to the roles we want to see in light armor: Knives, Bows and Healers. We increase the power of Knives and Bows, and also making the game with a bow more convenient. Healers need more serious changes later. We want to make the game for this role more interesting, and the role itself more in demand.
Bows:
- Significantly reduced the time from pressing the key to the flight of the arrow. The overall rate of fire remained the same.
- Increased critical damage, changed the chances of a critical hit.
- Slightly increased the lower limit of damage. Changed the base stats of some bows.
- Ideal Position duration reduced to 10s  125%, added 15% defense ignore.
- Weak Spot ability damage 120% -> 150%.
- Deathly Blow ability damage 140% -> 170% (still has 8% chance to inflict Death Blow on 30% of the target's HP, bosses have lower chance and damage).
Healing:
- Increased the spread of the bonus between the tiers of the healer's tools (the difference in the quality of the weapon should become more noticeable).
- Increased the speed bonus for Medicines activation per level.
- The power of healing pets has been reduced, but the cooldown has become faster.
- Ability Sacrificial Prayer. Reduced HP cost 30%  170%, Smithereens 100% -> 125%.
Swords:
- Increased Parry bonus per level 0.3% -> 0.5%.
Axes:
Ability In Twain stamina cost increased 15 -> 20.

- Objects required for quests are now highlighted in the game world to make them easier to find.
- Guild leadership can now be transferred.
- Changed the mechanism of the bonus Chance of double extraction of rare resources. Now a rare resource is any item whose rarity is: "Rare (blue border)", "Epic (purple border)" and higher. Most resources have had their Rarity parameter changed.
- Improved feedback window.

Other changes:

Plague Island
Adventure awaits you on a gloomy island that has long been consumed by plague. Endless diseases and epidemics have left a serious imprint on the flora and fauna and the lifestyle of local residents. Staying in most areas is dangerous not only because of the starving critters and the risk of infection, but also other travelers trying to survive and get their hands on Morbium.

Morbium and other Plague Island rewards
Morbium (Ore of the Dead) - a valuable resource with which you can endow your blade or armor plates with special properties. Equipped with morbium, you can defeat even the most powerful critters on Plague Island. You will also need this equipment on the main continent to become stronger in PvE and PvP battles. 
But Plague Island is rich not only in the Ore of the Dead, but you can also get leprous hides and organs, grim wood, spores, arsenic, and many other materials, minerals, and herbs useful for almost all professions. Use new materials to construct improved production buildings, storages, and gloomy decorations for your territory. Craft new ingredients, medicines, and equipment. Get unique pets and mounts!

Plague Island world
Explore the Dark Forest and the dangerous Marshlands, the Plague City, with its maze of streets and large abandoned houses, many decayed corpses, and dangerous inhabitants. Get to the most distant places - Infected Bog and a new dungeon.

Plague Island release date

- Added Korean, but translation is not complete. We remind you that the game is translated by our community. If you would like to help translate the game into your native language, please email us at support@wildterra2.com.

Auction
To ensure that the Auction does not completely replace ordinary trade, communication, competition on one server remains - we have set a time limit on bids, as well as commissions: 10% from the seller when selling any item, as well as an additional 10% from the buyer when trading overseas (buying from another server).

notes.title: Update 2.0.275. Windmill, alcohol and other changes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/82a00233046487ade73c192e716df067bbb0c5b1.jpg

This update adds a wooden windmill, the ability to brew alcoholic drinks, and many other improvements and fixes.

New features and improvements:

- Added several stages of drunkenness with different effects and messages.

Fixes:

- Fixed a bug due to which the Double XP chance of defense skills was not applied for heavy shields.
- Fixed a bug due to which various objects could visually remain and accumulate in the hands when changing equipment.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.274

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.273

notes.title: Major Update. Agriculture, Cooking, Combat System and countering criminals
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/3271cc21a181f9bd5b57bdbbfade11ae7e943906.png

Ten new crops for farming have been added to the game. Complex dishes will be in demand, and their bonuses have been increased. The first major stage of improving the combat system has been completed and a new skill has been added. Introduced system to counteract provocateurs and murderers of peaceful players, solved the problem with a shortage of free dungeons, added rewards from additional packs, and many other improvements!

Thanks a lot for your support. Thanks to you, the game gets better with each update!

Changelog. Major Update 2.0.272

Hidden bags and rewards of additional packs
To receive new rewards, you must reactivate your key in the game!
- Added rewards from additional packs. Prosperous merchant pack: Secret merchant bag, Elephant mount. King pack: Valorous Knight companion (pet).
- Added recipes for crafting secret bags in a game way.

Countering killers of peaceful players
- Introduced a new system of penalties for attacking peaceful players. Provocateurs and murderers will receive temporary statuses "Criminal" and "Outlaw", thanks to which they risk losing items from their inventory and part of the money upon death, even while in a peaceful zone!

Agriculture and Cooking
- Now you can grow: beets, cabbage, peas, onions, garlic, strawberries, grapes, apples, cherries, and pears. Some seeds can be obtained by breeding, and some can only be purchased from a merchant. Now there is no need to dig holes before sowing, and also, all actions are performed immediately with the bed, and not with single cells. *It will not work to plant new crops in old beds, you need to build new ones.
- Improved cooking system and food effect bonuses. Now you need to eat cooked food to restore your satiety score above 50%. Added new recipes, as well as a rolling pin and butcher hatchets. Also, food effects are now divided into several groups and only one effect from each group can be active on a player at a time.

New skill and other changes to the combat system
- Shields are now divided into light and heavy (both the items themselves and the skills for their possession). Added new active and passive abilities to both skills. Blocking melee and ranged attacks are now separate stats.
- Reworked the aggression system for mobs. The "Provocation" active ability has been added to the Heavy Shields skill. Players can now provoke a target on themselves by acting as tanks. The effectiveness of the ability depends on the level of the Heavy Shields skill. Dealing high damage can also cause a mob to change its target.
- Added a new random unlockable bonus for pets "Provocation", which will significantly increase the level of aggression when triggered, which will make the pet a full-fledged tank.
- During the battle, you can no longer change armor and remove a heavy shield. The effect lasts 7 seconds after you attack or get hit.
- Now after disconnecting or exiting the game, the character remains in the game for another 10 seconds. Consider this and exit the game in a safe place.
- Parry can now only be triggered during your attack.
- The growth rate of skills Parry, Light and Heavy shields is increased.
- Rebalanced the characteristics of all armor and shields. Now it will be possible to reach the maximum values of the parameters of dodge and defense only with equipment of a high level and quality. Also, parts of one set of armor will give a different percentage of bonuses, depending on the amount of resources and skill required to create it. *For example, the chest armor will give more than the gloves.*

Other changes and bug fixes:
- The number of simultaneously open dungeons has been significantly increased (you will no longer have problems entering and waiting).
- Fixed a bug due to which the Boar pet was not triggering the Fury ability.
- Fixed a bug due to which player's buildings could block the passages.
- Fixed a bug due to which some buildings could be built at the same point many times. All half-timbered roofs on the server have been removed to reduce the load.
- Some mobs and bosses will now be more difficult to defeat.
- Fixed a bug due to which volume control did not affect fireworks.
- Fixed a bug due to which bonuses could be triggered for broken weapons.
- Fixed a bug due to which the critical hit chance did not work when attacking with knives from the back.
- Fixed a bug due to which Parry could be triggered without weapons, with bows or throwing weapons.
- Fixed a bug due to which spears and sling projectiles could fly through the wall if you approach it at close range.
- Improved and optimized graphics of trees, wooden boxes, half-timbered roof.

notes.title: Update 2.0.270. Map, pack rewards and many fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/b55bffe0474af86b05b9bdf0b2ab8ce4b5b69947.png

notes.title: Update 2.0.269. Mute player and other chat options, new places to settle
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/ce4c1dc38ab1406ce3384ae8b8ba8e0110e2c91c.png

Added a button to ignore all messages from the player in the chat, the ability to copy the text of messages, invite the sender to a group or guild. Thanks to the sound notification, you will no longer miss a private message. And now there are more places to settle on Mainland!

Changelog. Update 2.0.269

New features and improvements
- Now, when you click on a message in the chat, you have the opportunity: mute player (ignore all messages from him), copy the text of the message, write a private message to the sender, invite to your group or guild.

Fixes

- Fixed shooting through walls in the "Dwarven fortress" dungeon.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes could cause incomplete loading of items into containers when restarting the server.
- Fixed a bug due to which, when disconnecting from the server at the time of the completion of a trade operation, the money for the deal was sometimes not transferred.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.268
notes.notes:
With this update, server restart will be accompanied by special warnings 5 minutes before server restart. If you try to connect to the server at the time of its restart, the corresponding messages will be displayed.

Fixes and improvements
- When dying in a dungeon, you will no longer be thrown out. Now, you appear at the beginning of the location. Resurrection waiting time in dungeons increased to 20 seconds. The waiting time for resurrection in other places has been increased to 10 seconds.

- Fixed a bug due to which the Appearance effect did not subside if the character continued to move towards the selected target.
- Fixed display of the timer for effects and skill cooldowns, now the value 0 should not appear there if the time is less than a second.

notes.title: Update 2.0.267. Protecting peaceful players and freeing up space on Main Land
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/2cdad86bc5e5706b5b1e19adb8b74b2ac234fd8c.jpg

The timers for the long absence of players have been reduced so that space for new dominiums is quickly freed up. We remind you that in case of a long absence you will not lose anything, your dominium with all the buildings and contents of the warehouses will be packed into your inventory.
Introduced measures to protect peaceful players from griefers, sprout timers are now saved, and servers are working even faster!

Changelog. Update 2.0.267

Fixes and improvements
- Now the absence time before auto-packing of the dominium on the continent is 3, 6 and 10 days (basic, medium, large, respectively). Timers have been reduced to prevent inactive players from taking up space on the Continent.
- Now, if you lose consciousness from the actions of another player in a peaceful zone, you will receive a temporary effect “Tranquility”, in which you do not take damage from other players until you start attacking them yourself or enter the danger zone.
- Now sprouts keep their timers even if the server is restarted.
- The watered Cereals stage is now more visible.
- Changed the hotkey for the action of demolishing a building in edit mode, and the action itself is now displayed in red to avoid accidental deletion by mistake.
- Increased the distance at which catching animals is triggered.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to transfer Dominium stones and a log shed to the upper floors and foundations.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to transfer a hut and a stone foundation to the upper floors and foundations.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was possible to appear at the place of death if disconnected from the server.
- Fixed a bug sometimes causing a red error in the console when selecting channels and pressing Enter.

Server optimization
- Optimized places of saving, updating and deleting world objects and mobs in the database.
- Optimized write-off in the base: shells, bait, water, seeds, and durability, which could lead to slowdowns of the player's actions and increase the load on the server.
- Optimized saving to the database of mob deaths, generating loot for godsends, chests and mobs.

notes.title: Server Hotfix 2.0.266
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug due to which the repair of items did not work.
- Fixed a bug due to which, when entering a dungeon, you could find duplicate mobs.
- Work has been done with a possible fix of desynchronization of mobs.
- Improved sorting of containers and inventory to remove its impact on server load.
- Fixed bugs causing a message about the use of the inventory, even if it was not used at this time.
- Now the hangman's grave cooldown is 1 hour.

notes.title: Update 2.0.266. Improved server and client optimization
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/768be6e1eba37e1c5998398dc205e1b996885168.jpg

Deep profiling of the server was done and many bottlenecks were fixed based on the received data. Client performance has also been improved (most noticeable on High and Normal graphics settings).

We will continue to monitor the situation and improve the stability of the game, this is a top priority for us!

Changelog. Update 2.0.266

Server and client optimization
- Significantly optimized several bottlenecks identified during real server profiling.
- Optimized some textures.
- Very low quality settings now use even less memory.
- High and Normal settings no longer use shadow cascades.
- Reduced GPU instancing for some buildings and spawn objects.
- Disabled processing of shadows on small and low spawn objects and buildings, as well as projectiles.

Improvements and fixes
- The number of dungeons that can be created at the same time is doubled.
- Fixed a critical error due to which, if you exit the game before the grave appears, or without pressing the Resurrect button, the character was not sent to the save point, he appeared near the place of death.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was sometimes possible to gather one resource at the same time by several players.
- Fixed a bug due to which it was impossible to open a grave with a loot of a killed character until he pressed the Rebirth button.
- Fixed the effect of wind on the grass, the settings of which got lost in the last update.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.265. Lost items restored, optimization improved
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that in some cases led to the disappearance of items when working with warehouses. All lost items have been restored. Small client optimization improvements that will raise a bit FPS.

We apologize for the overflowing inventory, but this was the only way to restore items so quickly.

Hotfix 2.0.265

- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused items to disappear when working with warehouses.
- Now, even with empty satiety, stamina will gradually recover in order to eliminate the situation when the hungry one could not collect food for himself, because stamina is also spent on collecting food.
- Optimized synchronization of some components on the client.

notes.title: Update 2.0.264. Improving server optimization
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/2e65c8080c4c116561e2f3c0e4f4580d8285623c.png

Optimization

- Optimized unpacking and placement of dominium after relocation, as well as building and upgrading a ship.

notes.title: Update 2.0.260. Chat redesign, Feudal lords and Peons
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220547/adbf0e0aa1a3d88029e27264a5e48a089f48018e.png

The wipe before Early Access release will take place on January 26 at 9:00 am PST.

In this update, chat has been completely redesigned, adding origin selection when creating a character, a helmet for Builder pack owners, and other improvements and fixes.


Changelog. Update 2.0.260

Added Italian and Japanese languages. Thanks to everyone who helps translate the game!

Completely redesigned Chat 
- Chat channels are now tabbed. You can choose to display all messages at once, or messages from a specific channel, for example, "Trade".
- Now in the drop-down list, you can choose which channel your message will be sent to. 
- Now you can scale the chat window, move it, or completely hide it, leaving only the icon.
- Added display of notifications about new messages. For example, if the active tab is currently "Private", then when new messages appear in the "Group" or "Guild" channel, you will see a notification next to the tab icon.
We will continue to improve chat, with new features coming in the future, such as “Show Item in Chat”.

Feudal lords and Peons
- Now, when creating a character, you will be offered a choice of origin: create a Feudal lord, or a Peon. (All current characters will automatically become Feudal Lords).

Feudal Lord:
- May have land for buildings (i.e. own the Dominium)..
- He starts on the Starting Island, after completing tutorial quests, he will go to the continent with a base set of resources, buildings, and money. 
- You can have no more than 1 feudal lord on your account.

Peon:
- Can not have their own land.
- Starts on a continent with no money or resources (skips starting quests).
- You will need to become a resident of the feudal lord (you can settle on your Feudal Lord land).

In this demo version you will be limited only by the end date of the festival. In everything else - this is the full version of the game at the current moment of development.

We are a small indie team from Russia. At the moment, our team has only 4 people. We has already 3 fully released games, including our flagship Wild Terra. This game appealed to many players, and for several years we have continued to support it after the release, releasing patches with new content and conducting various events.

The core of our team is fans of sandbox games since Ultima Online and to this day. Largely thanks to this game, our team came together to make the sandbox of our dreams. Wild Terra 2: New Lands is also based on the spirit of old-school isometric games, a cozy Middle Ages, warm communication with new meetings, lots of opportunities and new challenges.

The game is developed without investment and publishers. We will make it exactly as we and the community wish. However, this approach has another side - we are very limited in funds for development. That is why we need your support.
